name: crowdstrike_guardian
label: CrowdStrike Falcon Guardian
description: CrowdStrike Falcon Guardian is CrowdStrike's AI detection and response (AIDR) solution. This connector queries the AI agent inventory (agents, sessions, installations, tools, skills, MCP servers, models), per-invocation activity (executions with model and token counts, tool and skill usage, prompts), the agentic graph (process tree, network and file events), and detections involving AI agent processes, and ingests those detections as FortiSOAR alerts on a schedule. Requires a Falcon API client with the AIDR: READ scope.

operations.title: List AI Agents
operations.description: Lists AI agents from the Guardian AIAgent entity store, filtered by product or hostname and windowed by time_range on LastSeen. Records carry the opaque agent Id (pass it to Get AI Agent), the 32-hex SensorId (the host id that event queries filter on), the AgentIds content hashes, the product (a numeric tag id with a friendly AgentProductName sibling) and the seen timestamps.

parameters.title: AI Product
parameters.description: (Optional) Filter by AI product name, for example CLAUDE_CODE or CURSOR. Pick from the dropdown or type a name; spaces and hyphens are normalized to underscores.

operations.title: Get AI Agent
operations.description: Gets one AI agent record by its opaque agent Id (the Id value from List AI Agents, not the 32-hex SensorId and not an AgentIds content hash). The record carries SensorId, which the host-scoped follow-up actions (List AI Tool Usage, List AI Executions, List AI Detections) take.

parameters.title: Agent Id
parameters.description: The AIAgent Id, the opaque record token from List AI Agents (for example ASCWQseSk3b76g...).
parameters.tooltip: The AIAgent Id, the opaque record token from List AI Agents (for example ASCWQseSk3b76g...).

operations.title: List AI Agent Sessions
operations.description: Lists AI agent sessions windowed by time_range on LastSeen, optionally by product. The route has no host filter: SensorId and AIAgentIds are never populated on this entity, so sessions cannot be scoped to one agent or host. Each record carries the session record Id, the AgenticSessionId UUID, the models invoked and the working directory.

operations.title: List AI Executions
operations.description: Lists AI agent process executions with the model and token counts for each (LogScale AgenticSessionStart; one row per process a session spawned). This is the only action that reports token usage (AgenticInputTokens / AgenticOutputTokens), and the only way to see the sessions on a given host: pass Sensor Id (aid), because the agent-sessions route has no host filter. Defaults to a 2-hour window like the API; widen Time Range for older activity (7d max).

operations.title: List AI Detections
operations.description: Lists detections involving AI agent processes. The Agent Id parameter takes the 32-hex SENSOR/host id (AIAgent.SensorId, the aid), not the opaque AIAgent.Id; the API parameter name is misleading. Records carry Severity (0-100) and RiskScore (different metrics), the MITRE tactic and technique, the agentic product tag and a deep link into the Falcon console.
